title: Flock Wants a Closely Surveilled World with No Exit
summary: This New Yorker article examines Flock, a company deploying AI-powered license plate recognition cameras across US communities, creating a pervasive surveillance network. The piece critiques the normalization of constant monitoring, arguing it builds a world with no exit from surveillance. Hacker News discussion (560 points, 536 comments) debates privacy, policing, and the ethics of automated tracking.
